shortDescription: Create and manage DNS Zone on the Hetzner Cloud.

options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: The endpoint for the Hetzner Cloud API. You can also set this option by using the C(HCLOUD_ENDPOINT) environment variable.

options.name: api_endpoint_hetzner
options.description: The endpoint for the Hetzner API. You can also set this option by using the C(HETZNER_ENDPOINT) environment variable.

options.name: api_token
options.description: The token for the Hetzner Cloud API. You can also set this option by using the C(HCLOUD_TOKEN) environment variable.

options.name: id
options.description: ID of the Zone to manage. Only required if no Zone O(name) is given.

options.name: mode
options.description: Mode of the Zone. Required if the Zone does not exist.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the Zone to manage. Only required if no Zone O(id) is given or the Zone does not exist. All names with well-known public suffixes (e.g. .de, .com, .co.uk) are supported. Subdomains are not supported. The name must be in lower case and must not end with a dot. Internationalized domain names must be transcribed to Punycode representation with ACE prefix, e.g. xn--mnchen-3ya.de (münchen.de).

options.name: primary_nameservers
options.description: Primary nameservers of the Zone. Only applicable for Zones with O(mode=secondary).

options.name: state
options.description: State of the Zone. C(import) is not idempotent.

options.name: zonefile
options.description: Zone file to import. Optional if O(state=present) and the Zone does not exist, ignored otherwise. Required if O(state=import).
